description: Frozen evaluation metric definitions, mathematical formulas, acceptance thresholds, cohort memberships, and quality oracles for APGR v0.13 adaptive context evaluation.

measurement_standards.units: controlled UTF-8 bytes and Unicode characters

delivery_event_accounting.initial_delivery: Initial prompt, provider instructions, mandatory doctrine, tool definitions, and turn-1 skill bodies
delivery_event_accounting.mandatory_instruction_overhead: Provider-specific instruction files (e.g. codex/AGENTS.md 7,939 B, claude/CLAUDE.md 11,071 B, antigravity/GEMINI.md 4,238 B)
delivery_event_accounting.tool_schema_overhead: Provider-native tool declaration payloads for MCP and CLI adapters
delivery_event_accounting.late_recovery_delivery: Exact skill bodies delivered on demand via MCP tool call or CLI stdout during subsequent turns
delivery_event_accounting.repeat_delivery: Actual second transmissions of previously delivered skill bodies count again in cumulative delivery metrics; overlapping representations of a single event are not double-counted

token_overhead_policy.policy_rule: APGR-controlled bytes are never generalized to total tokens. Missing provider token measurements remain unavailable and cannot pass promotion gates.

initial_controlled_byte_savings.target_threshold: median >= 0.20 (20% reduction) evaluated over savings_eligible_cohort members {06, 08, 09, 10, 11, 15}; savings_eligible_calibration_subset {01, 02, 04} is development-only and never feeds the default-flip decision

cumulative_controlled_byte_growth.percentile_method: nearest-rank p95: sort n finite observations in ascending order, index = ceil(0.95 * n) - 1
cumulative_controlled_byte_growth.target_threshold: nearest-rank p95 <= 0.10 (10% ceiling) evaluated over savings_eligible_cohort members {06, 08, 09, 10, 11, 15}

formulas.missing_data_rule: A required paired measurement that is unavailable fails the gate; it is never imputed, defaulted to zero, or excluded post hoc.

initial_controlled_delivered_bytes.definition: Total controlled UTF-8 bytes delivered to the provider prompt, mandatory doctrine, and tool definitions on turn 1 of an actor binding.
initial_controlled_delivered_bytes.target_threshold: >= 20% median reduction compared to paired static baseline on savings_eligible_cohort

cumulative_controlled_delivered_bytes.definition: Cumulative controlled UTF-8 bytes delivered across all turns of an actor binding, including initial prompt, tool schemas, and late-acquired skill bodies.
cumulative_controlled_delivered_bytes.target_threshold: <= 10% nearest-rank p95 growth compared to paired static baseline on savings_eligible_cohort

miss_recovery_rate.definition: Proportion of deliberately withheld or deferred applicable skills that are successfully discovered and acquired on demand when required.
miss_recovery_rate.target_threshold: 1.0 (100% exact recovery on all mandatory recovery scenarios: 10, 11, 12, 14)

exact_body_identity.definition: Cryptographic equality between the SHA-256 hash of the late-acquired skill body and the canonical source skill body.
exact_body_identity.target_threshold: true (zero tolerance for truncated, hallucinated, or modified skill bodies)

authority_preservation.definition: Verification that read-only actor bindings execute zero repository mutations, zero index modifications, and zero HEAD moves during late acquisition.
authority_preservation.target_threshold: true (zero authority regressions allowed across all scenarios)

git_immutability_oracle.description: Asserts worktree, index, and HEAD identities match before and after read-only turns unless worktree drift is explicitly dispositioned under policy.

mandatory_doctrine_oracle.description: Asserts non-negotiable repository doctrine (authority rules, review restrictions) is present in 100% of delivered context payloads regardless of budget limits.

deterministic_reproducibility_oracle.description: Asserts identical semantic inputs (run ID, binding, attempt, repo state) produce byte-identical context plans.

quality_task_outcome_oracle.description: Asserts scenario execution completes with substantive task correctness matching expected output, not merely terminating with status 'completed'.

correction_revision: APG159A-CORR1 (supersedes the APG159 numerical freeze retained in history)

value_source_vocabulary.measured: Exact byte count reproduced from a named file at the recorded tree by a stated command.
value_source_vocabulary.synthetic: Byte count of a synthetic fixture body embedded verbatim in the scenario; never evidence of canonical corpus savings.
value_source_vocabulary.estimate: Planning placeholder with no measurement command; must be replaced by a measured value before it feeds any gate.
value_source_vocabulary.declared: A frozen scenario parameter (for example a budget) chosen by the correction revision, not a measurement.
value_source_vocabulary.unavailable: Required data that no qualified measurement supplies; never treated as zero.

synthetic_input_rule: Scenarios with synthetic_inputs=true (08, 09) contribute paired ratios computed over identical synthetic inputs in both arms. The default-flip gate is evaluated twice: over the full savings_eligible_cohort and over the subset excluding synthetic-input scenarios. Both evaluations must pass; the smaller n is disclosed.
small_sample_disclosure: savings_eligible_cohort has n=6 (n=4 excluding synthetic-input scenarios; n=3 if scenario 15 remains contingent). With n<=6 the nearest-rank p95 is the maximum observation. This is an engineering gate, not a statistical population guarantee.
